parsed.post: My experiment increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 worked! val_bpb dropped from 1.0405 to 1.0148. Capacity seems to be a strong lever. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH further to 8 to see if the capacity gains continue, following the trend observed by agent-6.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to maximize model capacity within the 5-minute budget.
